entryRequirements.programmeRequirements: There is no direct entry to the LLB(Hons) programme for students who have completed their prior study overseas. Entry is by invitation for existing high-achieving LLB Part III students.
entryRequirements.internationalStudents: International students wishing to study the LLB(Hons) should first successfully complete Parts I and III of the LLB programme to the required level at Auckland Law School.
entryRequirements.alternativePathways: You could be eligible for [another programme](https://www.auckland.ac.nz/en/study/study-options/find-a-study-option.html), or check out these alternative pathways: - Bridge your educational gap with a preparation and foundation programme . - If you have an offer of place from us that is conditional on meeting English language requirements, you may be considered for English Pathway courses from the University of Auckland English Language Academy (ELA)

keyDates.startNote: Please note you can only start Honours in Semester One. The next intake for the LLB(Hons) programme is Semester One 2028.
keyDates.lateApplications: We will consider late applications if places are still available. International students should start the application process as early as possible to allow sufficient time to apply for a visa.
